description: This file defines the CharCountBased class, which extends RegexBasedAbstract. It appears to be part of a data generation module for routing, specifically implementing a chunk processing strategy based on character counts for route regex construction.

classes.name: CharCountBased
classes.description: A class that generates route regexes and suffixes for fast route matching using character counts.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of chunks to process, set to a fixed value of 30.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a batch of regex to route mappings, creating a combined regex pattern with suffixes and a route map.
